question: Who among the following has received Rajiv Gandhi Puraskar, Indira Priyadarshini Samman and Rotary International Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shovana Narayan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shovana Narayan has received the **Rajiv Gandhi Puraskar, Indira Priyadarshini Samman, and Rotary International Award among many others.**
 
• Shovana Narayan is a renowned Indian Kathak dancer who has made significant contributions to the field of Kathak, a classical Indian dance form​​.
 
• She has been recognized for her work with **several prestigious awards, including the Rajiv Gandhi Puraskar, Indira Priyadarshini Samman, and Rotary International Award​​.**
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Puraskar recognizes individuals for their outstanding contributions in various fields.
 
• **The Indira Priyadarshini Samman is another prestigious award given to individuals for exceptional achievements in their respective fields.**
 
• **The Rotary International Award is given by Rotary International, a global organization of business and professional leaders, to recognize individuals for their notable contributions in different areas.**
